calls.summary: Maria Callahan, who runs an HVAC company, called about upgrading to the Signature Plan for social media management and AI reviews. Oscar reviewed the $399 monthly pricing and the waived onboarding fee, then scheduled a demo for the following week. Maria was enthusiastic and confirmed all of her details.

Derek Nguyen, owner of a beauty salon, called to add Social Boosts and automated reviews to his current plan. Lila explained how the done-for-you social campaigns work and booked a demo to finalize the package. Derek scheduled the demo and sounded eager to grow bookings.

Trevor Okafor, a plumbing contractor, called asking about Search Boosts and local SEO to rank higher in Google. Rosey outlined the managed SEO service and scheduled a demo to map out target keywords. Trevor booked the demo and was pleased with the plan.

James Whitfield, who is opening a new pet care business, called to schedule a demo of the Signature Plan and get set up. Lee collected his business name, phone, and email, walked through the website and listings features, and booked the demo. James was ready to move forward as a new client.

Angela Restrepo, an auto repair shop owner, called about Online Listings syncing across 60+ directories. Mary explained how the listings auto-update and scheduled a demo to show the dashboard. Angela booked the demo and was satisfied with the answers.

Brandon Silva called to check the status of his Online Listings sync after signing up last week. Mike confirmed the listings were propagating across directories and would finish within 24-48h. Brandon was reassured but did not need a demo.

Priya Anand called to dispute a charge on her Signature Plan invoice, saying she was billed the onboarding fee that should have been waived. Jennifer reviewed the account, filed a billing correction, and issued a credit. Priya remained mildly frustrated but accepted the fix.

Kevin Doyle called because his professional website was showing an outdated phone number and a broken contact form. Rose logged a support ticket and escalated it to the web team for a fix. Kevin was annoyed by the delay but agreed to wait for the update.

Nadia Farouk called to cancel her Social Boosts add-on because she felt engagement had not improved. Sue reviewed the recent reports and offered to adjust the campaign, but Nadia asked to cancel anyway. Sue processed the cancellation request.

Marcus Feld called to complain that his Ads Boosts were not generating enough calls despite the monthly ad spend. Oscar reviewed the campaign metrics and promised an optimization review with the ads team. Marcus stayed skeptical and wanted results soon.

Sofia Mendez called asking how the automated reviews feature requests feedback from customers. Lila explained the AI review management and booked a demo to show the reputation dashboard. Sofia scheduled the demo before ending the call.

Aaron Blake called to cancel his Signature Plan, citing budget cuts at his law firm. Jennifer offered the Starter Plan as a downgrade, but Aaron insisted on canceling. Jennifer logged the cancellation and the account close date.

Rachel Kim left a voicemail asking about Search Boosts pricing for her home services company after hours. The call rolled to voicemail and no agent was available to take it. A follow-up was queued for the next business day.

Victor Hale called upset that his website redesign was behind schedule and his listings still showed the wrong hours. Mike apologized, escalated both issues, and set expectations for a resolution timeline. Victor remained dissatisfied with the progress.

Elena Rossi called furious about a duplicate charge and threatened to cancel all of her services. Sue reviewed the billing history, confirmed the duplicate, and started a refund while trying to retain the account. Elena stayed angry and undecided about staying.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: Yes, the caller runs a small HVAC contracting firm and is losing leads to larger competitors with strong Google visibility. They struggle with consistent social media updates and managing online reviews, which directly affects their ability to win more bookings in their service area.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects a platform that can help them be found online across listings and Google, manage their social presence without hiring staff, and boost their reputation through review management. They want to understand pricing and see a demo before committing, especially to determine if Signature or Amplify plan best fits their two-location operation.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent built good rapport and qualified the core need effectively, but missed capturing the email address and did not set clear expectations about the demo timeline or what the caller should prepare. Adding a brief mention of onboarding support and the AI Lead Insights revenue-lift benefit would have strengthened perceived value.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Thryv, this is Marcus speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. I run a small HVAC company in the Denver area, two locations, and we're losing jobs to competitors who seem to dominate Google and have active social media. I heard Thryv might help with that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's a great fit for us, and I'm glad you reached out. A lot of HVAC contractors are in the same boat. Thryv specializes in getting service businesses like yours found online and winning more bookings. Can I get your name first?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, it's Robert Chen.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Robert. So when you say you're losing jobs to competitors, are you mostly looking to improve your Google visibility, or are social media and reviews also a concern?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: All three, honestly. We're okay on Google Maps, but it's inconsistent. Our review count is low compared to competitors, and we do not post on social media at all. That's hurting us.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That makes total sense. Our platform covers all three areas. We can auto-sync your business info across 60 plus directories, manage your reviews with AI assistance, and handle social posting so you do not have to. We serve both of your locations from one dashboard. Your service area is Colorado, correct?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, Denver metro area, both locations. We service parts of Boulder County too.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. So we have a couple of plans. Our Signature plan at 399 a month includes the website builder, all listing syncing, review management, social media management for up to five profiles, and lead insights. There's also an Ads Boosts option if you want us to manage paid search campaigns to drive even more calls. Does that sound like something worth exploring?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, absolutely. What's the onboarding like? And how quickly do we start seeing results?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Onboarding is usually just a quick setup call where we get your branding and service area details locked in. Most clients start seeing activity and lead scoring within the first week or two. You'll have a dedicated support team via phone and email 24/7. I'd love to get you booked in for a demo so we can walk through the whole platform and customize which features make most sense for your two locations. What day works best for you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: How about next Wednesday afternoon? I'm pretty flexible between 1 and 4 PM.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, I'll get you on the calendar for next Wednesday between 1 and 4 PM. One more thing, Robert, just to confirm your phone number we have on file is ****2847, is that still the best way to reach you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great. I'll send over a calendar invite and a quick prep guide before the demo so you know what to expect. Thanks so much for calling Thryv, Robert. We're excited to help you win more bookings. Have a great rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thanks, Marcus. Talk soon.

qaPairs.question: What is Thryv?
qaPairs.answer: Thryv is an all in one small business software and marketing platform that helps local service businesses get found, win more customers, and grow faster. The best next step is a personalized demo so we can tailor it to your business.

qaPairs.question: How much does Thryv cost?
qaPairs.answer: Plans start at $99 per month for Starter and $399 per month for Signature, with Amplify custom priced for larger needs. A specialist can build an exact quote for you on a quick demo.

qaPairs.question: What is included in the Starter Plan?
qaPairs.answer: Starter includes a digital marketing score, an AI website builder, posting to 60 plus listing directories, AI review management, trackable phone numbers, and 24/7 chat support. I can book a demo to show it in action.

qaPairs.question: What is included in the Signature Plan?
qaPairs.answer: Signature includes everything in Starter plus social media management, an SEO and AEO custom website, advanced listings, competitive insights, AI Lead Insights, and 24/7 phone and email support. Let's set up a demo so a specialist can walk you through it.

qaPairs.question: What is the Amplify Plan?
qaPairs.answer: Amplify includes everything in Signature plus a Custom Boosts Suite, and it is tailored to businesses looking to attract more leads. Pricing is custom, so a specialist can quote it on a demo.

qaPairs.question: What are Thryv Boosts?
qaPairs.answer: Thryv Boosts are done for you marketing services where our experts manage your ads, social media, listings, and search visibility to drive more clicks and calls. A demo is the best way to see which Boosts fit your goals.

qaPairs.question: Do you help with Google reviews?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Reputation Management uses AI to monitor, acknowledge, and request reviews automatically to build your online reputation. I can schedule a demo to show how it works for your business.

qaPairs.question: Can Thryv build me a website?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Starter includes an AI website builder and Signature includes a professionally designed website with SEO and AEO tools. Let's book a demo so a specialist can review your options.

qaPairs.question: Does Thryv manage my social media?
qaPairs.answer: Signature includes social media management with a post calendar, content library, CaptionAI and ImageAI, and up to 5 profiles. A demo can show you the full workflow.

qaPairs.question: What industries do you work with?
qaPairs.answer: We support automotive, beauty and salon, health and wellness, home services, HVAC, legal, pet care, plumbing, and professional services. Book a demo and we'll tailor everything to your industry.

qaPairs.question: How does Thryv help me get more leads?
qaPairs.answer: Thryv Leads and Ads Boosts drive qualified leads while AI Lead Insights scores and prioritizes your hottest prospects. A specialist can map this out for you on a demo.

qaPairs.question: What is the onboarding fee?
qaPairs.answer: There is a one time $250 onboarding fee, and it is waived when you choose the Signature Plan. I can book a demo to confirm current offers for you.

qaPairs.question: How does listing management work?
qaPairs.answer: Online Listings automatically syncs your business info across 60 plus sites including Google, Yelp, Nextdoor, and Yahoo. Let's set up a demo to see it live.

qaPairs.question: Can I track my phone calls?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, trackable phone numbers are included so you can see which marketing drives your calls. A demo will show you the full analytics dashboard.

qaPairs.question: How is Thryv different from competitors?
qaPairs.answer: Thryv combines software and done for you marketing services in one platform, backed by over 125 years helping local businesses and trusted by 100,000 plus of them. A demo is the best way to compare it to your current tools.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer analytics and reporting?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, you get a digital marketing score, marketing dashboard, competitor ranking, heat mapping, and website analytics so you stop guessing. I can schedule a demo to walk through the reports.

qaPairs.question: Is there a free trial?
qaPairs.answer: Thryv offers ways to try the platform, and we can confirm the current options on your demo. Let's find a time that works for you.

qaPairs.question: How long does setup take?
qaPairs.answer: Setup timelines vary by plan and services, and your onboarding team guides you through each step. A specialist can give you a clear timeline on a quick demo.

qaPairs.question: Can Thryv help me get found in AI search?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Search Boosts help you stand out in both search and AI results so more customers can find you. Book a demo and a specialist will show how it applies to your business.

qaPairs.question: How do I get started?
qaPairs.answer: The easiest first step is a personalized demo where a specialist reviews your goals and builds an exact quote. I can find a day and time that works for you right now.

convo.text: Hi, thanks for calling Thryv. I see you're exploring our platform to grow your service business. Are you looking to book a demo today or just have a few quick questions?
Yeah, we run a home services company in Austin and we've been trying to get more leads through Google and local search. Your listing management and SEO tools caught our eye.

sigs.t: Home services company, local search focused

convo.text: Perfect fit. Our Search Boosts and Online Listings help home services companies get found by high-intent customers. How many locations are you managing, and would you say you're ready to move forward with a dedicated strategy?

We have three locations in the Austin area, and honestly yes, we're ready. We've been DIY-ing our marketing and it's taking too much time. We just want to know if it's going to work for our specific service type and what the investment looks like.

Excellent. I'm going to route you to our demo team who specializes in home services growth strategies. They'll walk you through how Thryv's Search Boosts, AI Lead Insights, and listing management work across your three locations and give you a clear ROI picture. Sound good?

signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["let's get your demo scheduled (Agent)", "book you a demo (Agent)", "I'd like to see a demo (Caller)", "put you on the calendar with a specialist (Agent)"])

signals.name: Competitor Comparison (Intent)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["right now I use Yelp (Caller)", "how do you compare to GoDaddy (Caller)", "we're on Housecall Pro (Caller)", "switching from Podium (Caller)"])

signals.name: Demo Discussed (Industry)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["walk you through the platform (Agent)", "tour of the dashboard (Agent)", "show you how the listings sync works (Agent)", "see it in action (Caller)"])

signals.name: Listings & Reviews Interest (Intent)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["get more Google reviews (Caller)", "update my business listings (Caller)", "show up on Yelp and Nextdoor (Caller)", "sync my info across directories (Agent)"])

signals.name: Next Steps Set (Quality)
signals.rules: scorecard[Next Steps Set] < 60 and duration > 45 sec

signals.name: Pricing Objection (Intent)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["that's out of my budget (Caller)", "why is the Signature Plan so much (Caller)", "is the onboarding fee waived (Caller)", "can you do anything on price (Caller)"])

signals.name: Quote Provided
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["the Signature Plan is $399 a month (Agent)", "Starter runs $99 per month (Agent)", "Ads Boosts start around $300 plus ad spend (Agent)", "I'll send over a custom quote (Agent)"])
